source: 外研社新标准选择性必修第四册 Unit 6 同主题完形(太空营/追星少年/第一颗卫星/鼓起勇气申请/参观天文台/首次太空行走)。用词限本单元/常见词,答案唯一,选项同词性,与阅读·听力关不撞文章。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: A Week at Space Camp

passages.title: Finding the Courage to Apply
passages.text: When I first saw the advertisement for the space programme, I almost did not (1)____. I was excited, but a small voice inside told me I was not (2)____ enough.
